description: This file defines the `GenericTransactionException` class, which extends `GenericEntityException`, and is used to represent transaction-related exceptions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes constructors for creating exceptions with message strings and nested throwables.

classes.name: GenericTransactionException
classes.description: A custom exception class used for handling transaction-specific errors within the OFBiz entity component.

methods.description: Constructor that accepts an exception message.
